name: champius
description: Champius Learning Management System - Full-stack application with NestJS backend and Next.js frontend

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix apps/api && npm install --prefix apps/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web "npm run start:api" "npm run start:web"
scripts.lint: npm run lint:api && npm run lint:web

author: Samin Zaman
